/*
===============================================================================
目的：检验「主线卡关」是否与后续继续游戏相关。

口径：
  - 人群：2026-07-29 创角，且当日挑战过主线（stage_fight / key = 1001）的账号。
  - 推断卡关：玩家当日最高主线关卡被挑战 >= 2 次；事件中没有真实胜负字段，
    因此只是一种“最终关卡重试”的代理，不能等同于服务端失败。
  - 当日继续：最后一次该最高关挑战后，仍有任意后续事件。
  - 隔日继续：次日 login；以及次日继续挑战主线。
  - 为降低进度混杂，除总体外按当日最终主线进度五分位分层比较。
===============================================================================
*/
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
CohortUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT v."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND v."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
StageAttempts AS (
    SELECT
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        COALESCE(TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(v.stage_id AS BIGINT)) AS stage_id,
        v."#event_time" AS event_time
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    INNER JOIN CohortUsers c ON v."#account_id" = c.account_id
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE v."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
      AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
StageStats AS (
    SELECT account_id, stage_id, COUNT(*) AS attempts, MAX(event_time) AS last_attempt_time
    FROM StageAttempts
    WHERE stage_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
FinalStage AS (
    SELECT account_id, stage_id AS final_stage_id, attempts AS final_stage_attempts, last_attempt_time
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY stage_id DESC) AS rn
        FROM StageStats s
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
UserGroups AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        final_stage_id,
        last_attempt_time,
        CASE WHEN final_stage_attempts >= 2 THEN '推断卡关（最终关重试≥2）'
             ELSE '未见最终关重试（对照）' END AS player_group,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY final_stage_id) AS progress_quintile
    FROM FinalStage
),
SameDayFollowup AS (
    SELECT
        g.account_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN v."#event_time" > g.last_attempt_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_post_final_stage_event
    FROM UserGroups g
    LEFT JOIN ta.v_event_18 v
      ON v."#account_id" = g.account_id
     AND v."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE b.user_id IS NULL OR v."#account_id" IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
NextDayActivity AS (
    SELECT
        g.account_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN v."$part_event" = 'login' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d1_login,
        MAX(CASE WHEN v."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
                      AND TRY_CAST(v.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d1_main_stage
    FROM UserGroups g
    LEFT JOIN ta.v_event_18 v
      ON v."#account_id" = g.account_id
     AND v."$part_date" = CAST(DATE_ADD('day', 1, DATE '2026-07-29') AS VARCHAR)
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON v."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE b.user_id IS NULL OR v."#account_id" IS NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
UserMetrics AS (
    SELECT
        g.*,
        COALESCE(s.has_post_final_stage_event, 0) AS has_post_final_stage_event,
        COALESCE(d.d1_login, 0) AS d1_login,
        COALESCE(d.d1_main_stage, 0) AS d1_main_stage
    FROM UserGroups g
    LEFT JOIN SameDayFollowup s ON g.account_id = s.account_id
    LEFT JOIN NextDayActivity d ON g.account_id = d.account_id
),
Summary AS (
    SELECT
        '总体' AS comparison_scope,
        player_group,
        COUNT(*) AS users,
        MIN(final_stage_id) AS min_final_stage_id,
        MAX(final_stage_id) AS max_final_stage_id,
        SUM(has_post_final_stage_event) AS same_day_continue_users,
        SUM(d1_login) AS d1_login_users,
        SUM(d1_main_stage) AS d1_main_stage_users
    FROM UserMetrics
    GROUP BY 1, 2

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CONCAT('最终进度五分位 Q', CAST(progress_quintile AS VARCHAR)) AS comparison_scope,
        player_group,
        COUNT(*) AS users,
        MIN(final_stage_id) AS min_final_stage_id,
        MAX(final_stage_id) AS max_final_stage_id,
        SUM(has_post_final_stage_event) AS same_day_continue_users,
        SUM(d1_login) AS d1_login_users,
        SUM(d1_main_stage) AS d1_main_stage_users
    FROM UserMetrics
    GROUP BY 1, 2, progress_quintile
)
SELECT
    comparison_scope AS "比较范围",
    player_group AS "玩家分组",
    users AS "玩家数",
    min_final_stage_id AS "最终关ID最小值",
    max_final_stage_id AS "最终关ID最大值",
    same_day_continue_users AS "最后挑战后当日仍有行为人数",
    ROUND(100.0 * same_day_continue_users / NULLIF(users, 0), 2) AS "当日继续率(%)",
    d1_login_users AS "D1登录人数",
    ROUND(100.0 * d1_login_users / NULLIF(users, 0), 2) AS "D1登录率(%)",
    d1_main_stage_users AS "D1继续主线人数",
    ROUND(100.0 * d1_main_stage_users / NULLIF(users, 0), 2) AS "D1继续主线率(%)"
FROM Summary
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN comparison_scope = '总体' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    comparison_scope,
    player_group;
